acceptance: The v-tag ruleset blocks update and deletion of refs/tags/v*, or the docs no longer claim it does and the release workflow verifies the tag object before publishing.
scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py records the chosen rule set so drift is caught.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review of dlv2-51. Changing the ruleset is an owner action. Agents share the owner account (ADR D4), so the real human gate for publishing is the pypi environment's required reviewers.
description:
The live ruleset v-tag-restricted (18774756) has only a `creation` rule. It does not block update or deletion of refs/tags/v*. docs/development/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md:187 says it prevents "creation or mutation", and docs/operations/release-artifacts.md says the tag ruleset "is what forbids moves". A moved tag would point a release at a different commit than the one that was tested.

Add update and deletion rules to the ruleset (owner settings change), or correct the ADR and docs and make the release workflow re-check the tag object at publish time.
